experiment: Training-only leave-one-entire-instance-out numerical reference; no learned-policy deployment.

methodology.split: Leave one entire instance out of training data only; both queries of that instance are excluded from scaling/hyperparameter/prior fitting.
methodology.representation: Native-unit mean of latest received condition per named quantity, selected by last_sequence then first_sequence, never labels. Full condition rows, units, sample counts/ranges and causal sequences are preserved in public_inputs.json.gz; no cross-condition pooling.
methodology.ridge: Fit held-instance then-available support using standardized nine-dimensional inputs and unpenalized intercept. Standardization uses other instances only. Alpha selected by their future-query MAE separately for support2/3.
methodology.affine: Standard OLS slope/intercept per quantity on held-instance support. Mixture posterior is prior_j * exp(-support_MSE_j/(2*temperature^2)); no held-target-dependent weight. Temperature selected using other instances only. Empirical-prior variant estimates expert frequencies with 30 EM steps and .1 symmetric pseudocount using other instances future labels only; it is not a discoveryworld rule label or an original formula.
limits: Numerical reference, not the main CDM; no policy deployment or native activation test. Within2Hz refers to an observed public valid setting, not hidden exact resonance.

Two support points interpolate every nonconstant single-variable affine candidate, so support residual alone cannot identify one. A third point can distinguish the candidates represented here, but near-collinearity or noisy conditions can remain ambiguous.

A nine-dimensional affine function has ten coefficients. Two or three supports underdetermine a general sum of quantities; a mixture of single-variable affine experts is not a general additive or nonlinear law learner. Low three-support error on these training instances does not establish held-law transfer.

No validation, heldout, seed modulo, hidden rule, or held-instance future target enters predictions. The empirical expert prior reflects only the other training instances, so it favors their observed patterns.
Unconstrained numerical predictions are not clipped to the native control range. Ill-conditioned two-point slopes can extrapolate far outside it.

interpretation: Known-anchor fitting is achievable with public native-unit measurements. Exact two-anchor interpolation does not identify a law or guarantee future accuracy. Within the single-variable affine candidate class, three observed working settings sharply distinguish hypotheses on these training instances. This is a numerical reference, not evidence of held-law transfer, native success, or an original inference mechanism.
